packageRules.description: toolchain pins are owned by `pnpm toolchain:sync` (installed node + pnpm are the truth): .node-version, packageManager and engines never move here — #41 re-pinned node to a patch fnm did not have
same contract for the manifest fields
patches: one grouped pr overnight, automerged once ci is green
minors: one grouped pr on monday morning, merged by hand

0.x never automerges: semver lets a 0.x package break in a patch, so these ride the monday pr for a human to read. renovate's own matchUpdateTypes docs say to do this. last rule on purpose — later rules win, so this overrides the patch tier above. matchCurrentVersion prefers the locked version, so it catches a 0.x behind a range too.

jotai major is held in x-com-chat: jotai 3 removed the INTERNAL_buildStoreRev3 export that jotai-devtools imports, and devtools' peer range `>=2.20.0` admits jotai 3 anyway, so nothing warns — the prod build just dies in turbopack. lift this the day a stable jotai-devtools (>0.14.0, not the 0.15.0-alpha) declares jotai 3. app-scoped on purpose; no other app uses jotai.
